title: Current Refund Processing Time Notice
text: Current refund processing takes 14 days from the received date and applies to requests received after the effective date

title: Refund Evidence Documents
text: When requesting a refund
source: the customer must submit the order number and payment receipt together

title: Old Return Review Archive
text: The old return standard said requests would be reviewed within 30 days under the previous rule

title: Partial Refund Exceptions
text: Partial refunds are approved after checking usage volume and contract conditions

title: Refund After Subscription Cancellation
text: Refunds for the remaining period after subscription cancellation depend on payment method and usage history

title: Refund Support Response Template
text: Customer refund inquiries should include the received date processing period and required documents

title: Settings Reset Procedure
text: To return settings to the initial state open Preferences and press the reset button before restarting

title: Turn Off Autosave
text: Autosave can be turned off in the Preferences Editing menu and changes must be saved afterward

title: Advanced Settings Location
text: In the current version advanced settings are under the Preferences Labs menu

title: Settings Restore Archive
text: In the previous version users restored defaults from the advanced settings screen

title: Change Notification Settings
text: Notification frequency is adjusted from the Preferences Notifications menu

title: Display Language Settings
text: The display language can be changed from the Language item in account settings

title: SDK Rate Limit Retry
text: When a rate limit occurs use exponential backoff and the max_retries option to adjust retry intervals

title: SDK Auth Object
text: The current SDK creates the client by putting the token in the auth object

title: API Timeout Setting
text: The timeout option sets the per request time limit and operates separately from the retry count

title: Authorization Header Archive
text: Older SDK examples put the token directly in the Authorization header

title: Webhook Signature Verification
text: Webhook requests are verified by comparing the signature header with the payload hash

title: Pagination Handling
text: List retrieval passes the cursor value to the next request to fetch the next page

title: Offboarding Asset Return
text: Before leaving the company the laptop and security key are returned to the security team desk

title: Account Deactivation Procedure
text: On the termination processing date work accounts and access permissions are deactivated in order

title: Offboarding Checklist
text: Departing employees complete equipment return reservation and document handover by the day before leaving

title: Asset Return Archive
text: The old standard instructed employees to return laptops to the general affairs counter

title: Security Card Return
text: Security cards are collected at the information desk on the last workday

title: Handover Document Location
text: Handover documents are uploaded to the offboarding folder on the team drive

title: Seat Pricing Table Location
text: The current seat based pricing table is available in the billing settings screen of the admin console

title: Monthly Billing Standard
text: Monthly billing is calculated from the number of active seats and usage period

title: Annual Contract Discount
text: Annual contract discounts vary by seat count tier

title: Pricing Plan Archive
text: The old pricing plans were offered only as Basic and Pro tiers

title: Tax Invoice Issuance
text: A tax invoice is issued after payment is complete and business information is verified

title: Change Payment Method
text: Payment method can be changed from billing settings in the admin console

title: Support Screenshot Standard
text: Screen guidance answers should first check the current manual path and screenshot standard

title: Notice Writing Rule
text: A notice should describe the effective date target and before after change in one paragraph

title: Privacy Inquiry Routing
text: Personal data access and deletion inquiries are routed to the privacy owner for review

title: Incident Notice Template
text: Incident notices include impact scope current status and next update time

title: Support Priority Standard
text: Support ticket priority is decided by considering affected user count and blocking severity

title: Release Note Writing
text: Release notes separate feature changes bug fixes and user actions
